name: Frailty Assessment
description: Mobility, ADLs, and medical complexity combined into a 12-point frailty score.

questions.title: Mobility
questions.help: Select the option that best describes the patient.

options.label: Uses walking aid or occasional assistance
Chair or bed bound most of the time

questions.title: Medical Complexity & Cognition
questions.help: Consider comorbidities, polypharmacy, cognition, and impact on function.

options.label: One or two stable chronic conditions
Severe comorbidity and/or advanced cognitive impairment

bands.label: Fit / Well
bands.action: No frailty identified. Continue routine care and monitoring per local guidance.

bands.label: Vulnerable (Pre-frail)
bands.action: Consider early intervention and risk reduction strategies per local guidance.

bands.label: Mild Frailty
bands.action: Consider targeted assessment and support needs per local guidance.

bands.label: Moderate Frailty
bands.action: Consider comprehensive assessment and multidisciplinary support per local guidance.

bands.label: Severe Frailty
bands.action: Consider urgent comprehensive assessment and care planning per local guidance.
